methodology.baseline: existing inventory + batch fill-plan + existing executor; fixture Agent decisions
methodology.enhanced: deterministic semantic mapping + compiler + same executor; fixture exception recipes
methodology.timing: real script/UI/save/receipt duration; excludes startup/navigation, model thinking and user approval
methodology.token_measurement: exact o200k_base tokenization of replay input/output text; not billed model usage
methodology.warm: fresh seed cache; seeding time excluded and upload rescan remains mandatory
limitations: Synthetic Agent decisions exclude model errors and latency.
Browser timing does not predict live ATS throughput.
No actual IAB/Chrome extension latency in this harness.
Existing baseline already batches; no per-field LLM strawman.
REA deep-analysis overhead is not measured.
Warm cache validates rules again; it is not permission to replay stale selectors.
